results.quote: For tie-free observations and fixed moment dimension, the full covariance matrix of the sample means, the second and third L-comoments, and the marginal second L-moments can be computed in O(n^2) arithmetic and O(n^2) memory using bivariate rank-prefix sums.

results.problem: Leading asymptotic covariance estimation for L-comoments
results.quote: Consequently, for tie-free observations, all n leave-one-out statistics, the empirical first projections (4.10), and $\widehat{\Omega}_n$ are computed in $O(n\log n)$ time for fixed moment dimension.
